title: Exclude literal P104 helper entrance raises (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** Independent forward and reverse walks agree on the first literal contact of all 1,101 productive public helpers on #7314. Both exhaust 76,461 events and count both ADD and COPY operands. All ten nonexcluded first MOVEs land on their final chart. Zero proper first MOVEs of any positive rank, zero admissible rank-one entrance raises and zero unresolved roles.

The complete signed price replaces the old target rank with its positive residual when removing a first paid rank-one MOVE. This would remove 17 paid positions, keep 22,461 productive positions and reduce both rank masses by 17. The optimistic one-edit upper is 0.1936058783583026 raw, with 186.73010468614004 for the whole relaxed stock. The fixed-suffix support upper is zero.

## Task and overlap

Round 58 of Discussion #7111. Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Comparator #7314 at 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91, κ = 0.003646221436446, signed caller #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The test fixes every later contact. #7122 changes seven helper entrances and 22 scalar charts on #7121. #2435 and #2453 study a width exchange, #6375 uses funded shared carriers, and #7142 adds a paid input extension for a separate split. The branch retains both published #7257 hosted-replay prerequisites with original authorship.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-entrance-first-contact-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-helper-entrance-first-contact-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
```

Registered replay, commit byte/mode/source authentication, Git-free export replay and six navigation tests passed locally. The package authenticates the comparator admission, regenerates four exact receipt hashes and rejects a changed caller and stale price pin. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

## Credit

#7314, #7113 and #7298 supply the exact comparator, signed caller and directed arithmetic. #7121–#7122 and #2435, #2453, #6375 and #7142 supply entrance and target precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

## Open next questions

A changed chronology or a different installed entrance needs its own complete price and exact signed arbitrary-input delivery, ownership and restoration proof.
